name: Assistance Towards Expenses Incurred for Raising of Funds through NSE’s/ BSE’s SME Exchange Platform
targetBeneficiaries: Businesses raising funds through NSE/BSE SME exchange platforms
briefDescription: The Government of Rajasthan provides one-time financial support, up to ₹15,00,000, towards expenses incurred by businesses for raising funds through NSE's/BSE's SME exchange platforms.
descriptionMd: This scheme by the Government of Rajasthan aims to support businesses and entrepreneurs in the state. It provides financial assistance to cover expenses incurred while raising capital. The support is specifically for businesses that utilize the National Stock Exchange (NSE) or Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) SME exchange platforms for equity fundraising.
benefitsMd:
*   One-time financial support for expenses incurred in raising funds.
*   Maximum assistance of ₹15,00,000/- per beneficiary.
eligibilityMd:
*   Businesses that have incurred expenses for raising funds.
*   Funds must have been raised through NSE’s/ BSE’s SME exchange platform.
*   Successful raising of equity is required.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
